summary: Applied Owner amendment A0002 at the SPEC layer to exactly the four PLANNED P04 contracts T040, T041, T042 and T043, rebasing them onto the per-pool dataset generation that T038 qualifies over the pinned finalized ten-million-block window and excluding the superseded 2026-09-18 reference dataset (run-680e65f4a59842d98b1712a45280779d) as an input or as a satisfied entry condition. T040 (Build deterministic event replay): Dependencies T012, T030, T034, T037, T038; References T037, T038, ADR-010, ADR-012, ADR-013, docs/spec/protocol/PROVIDER_FACTS.md, R4, R14; new 'Input datasets' section states that replay consumes one T038-qualified dataset per pool addressed by that pool's data root, that one replay input must not mix two pools' events, and that the superseded dataset and the superseded 1,000,001-block reference range are not replay inputs and no checkpoint may be derived from them. The existing ProtocolFeeUpdated requirement and the dynamic-fee clause are unchanged. T041 (Reconstruct tick-liquidity state): Dependencies T040, T037, T038; References T037, T038, T040, ADR-010, ADR-012, ADR-013, docs/spec/protocol/PROVIDER_FACTS.md, R3, R4; new 'Input scope' section states that tick and liquidity reconstruction is per pool over that pool's own qualified window and data root, and that a pool T038 reports as pool_init_outside_window is not reconstructed (no partial window, no later-state bootstrap, no neighbouring pool's data, no window widening). T042 (Validate replay against independent chain state): Dependencies T041, T038; References T034, T037, T038, T041, ADR-010, ADR-012, ADR-013, docs/spec/protocol/PROVIDER_FACTS.md, R7, R8; new 'Comparison scope, routing and bounds' section names the heterogeneous pool set as T038's two qualified pools (the re-acquired ZZZ/USDG reference pool and the Owner-pinned second pool), each validated against its own data root and replay output; fixes historical-state routing (block-pinned StateView reads go to an endpoint that can serve historical state at the pinned depth, an endpoint that cannot is a blocked check recorded with a T034 reason code, the height and the endpoint alias, and never becomes latest, an unpinned read, another height, or a post-hoc re-read); requires the runner to fix and record before running the number of heights compared per pool, the per-height read list and a logical-call and compute-unit budget ceiling, with exceeding the ceiling stopping the run instead of silently reducing coverage; and consumes T037's per-partition event_index-versus-Parquet reconciliation instead of re-implementing it. Deliverables, Acceptance and Must not carry those clauses and add no relaxation. T043 (Build hook semantics evidence packs): Dependencies unchanged at T023, T042; References T023, T037, T038, T042, ADR-010, ADR-012, ADR-013, docs/spec/protocol/PROVIDER_FACTS.md, R4, R6, R14; new 'Evidence scope' section defines the empty-set evidence for the case where neither included pool has nonzero hooks (the per-pool T023 classification outcome carrying the observed hooks value and the classification reason, the reason no hook pack exists, and an explicit statement that no hook semantics were verified, recorded as its own artifact), states that the empty-set path does not relax the complete-pack requirement for any pool with nonzero hooks promoted beyond ingestion, and keeps flags distinct from semantics. Spec layer: docs/spec/protocol/PROVIDER_FACTS.md gains a labelled section 'Finalized pinning and the research window (Owner decision 2026-09-18)' recording the window end as the finalized block agreed on number and hash by both qualified endpoints (never latest, never a wall-clock-derived bound), the window start min(end - 10_000_000, Initialize block of each included pool), the 2,000,000-block extension tolerance with the pool_init_outside_window exclusion, the unresolved second-pool PoolKey and Initialize block, and per-item provenance labels (Owner policy 2026-09-18, chain fact for the reference pool's Initialize block 54946237, run-specific measurement to re-probe every run), plus a labelled note that the measured values carry the document header's retrieval time 2026-09-17, chain id 4663 and endpoint aliases A and B. The same document gains a 'Dataset qualification records' section recording that run-680e65f4a59842d98b1712a45280779d is superseded and non-qualifying, that its event_index holds 3,739 rows across 3,266 distinct event blocks against 3,737 rows across 3,264 in Parquet with Swap at 3,157 against its pinned baseline 3,159, the two missing Swap keys (block 55586273 log index 53 transaction 0x17c7771d139bbf8f8cb7d5b7b1cd0ccb09ca6aefa43b6e36df400e26fb5e936e; block 55726297 log index 29 transaction 0xd75437f4a29d3763edf90eebc8cfd179f63b2f278f01d9b9663ac2ab0a5d79d4) and the writer-merge cause in RawPartitionWriter._merge_into_existing_partition, closed by T037. Added docs/spec/architecture/adr/ADR-013-finalized-window-pinning-and-partition-reconciliation.md as an addendum that refines ADR-002, ADR-010 and ADR-012 and relies on an unchanged ADR-011, registered it in the ARCHITECTURE.md ADR catalogue, and raised spec_revision from v1-2026-09-17 to v1-2026-09-18. No task status, attempt, base/candidate/approved commit, evidence pointer, review record, approval datum, runtime model, active task or agent configuration changed; the four tasks remain PLANNED at attempt 0.
rationale: Owner direction mapping, item by item. Section 1 (context) is carried as immutable historical evidence only: the superseded run is named and excluded, never presented as satisfying anything, and the storage-writer cause is recorded as the reason a per-partition index-versus-Parquet reconciliation exists. Section 2 (new input) is expressed through T038's contract rather than restated: T038 owns the finalized end agreed on number and hash, the start rule min(end - 10_000_000, Initialize) with the 2,000,000-block tolerance and the pool_init_outside_window exclusion, the cold re-acquisition of the ZZZ/USDG reference pool from Initialize block 54946237, the chain-resolved second pool PoolId 0xEd50bDeeA8aDC232f159486192a4157281D722ff with the keccak256(abi.encode(PoolKey)) == PoolId check, and one data root plus one T034 report per pool; the four P04 contracts now consume exactly that and add no range of their own. Section 3, T040: T037 and T038 added to Dependencies and References, per-pool data roots and the superseded-dataset exclusion stated in a dedicated section, ProtocolFeeUpdated and the dynamic-fee clause untouched. T041: T037 and T038 added to Dependencies and References, per-pool reconstruction over that pool's qualified window stated, and the window-excluded pool explicitly not reconstructed. T042: T038 added to Dependencies and References, the two-pool heterogeneous set named so the acceptance clause is satisfied by T038's datasets rather than by an unspecified source, historical-state routing stated with a blocked-check outcome instead of a latest substitution, the three cost bounds (heights compared, per-height read list, logical-call and compute-unit ceiling) made recordable and therefore reviewable, and T037's reconciliation consumed rather than re-implemented. T043: the zero-hooked-pool evidence shape defined with per-pool T023 classification outcomes and the reason no pack exists, an explicit no-semantics-verified statement, and no weakening of the complete-pack requirement for a nonzero-hook pool promoted beyond ingestion; flags remain distinct from semantics. Section 4: (a) the finalized-pinning and window rule is recorded in docs/spec/protocol/PROVIDER_FACTS.md with provenance and mutability labels, and no finalized height value is invented; (b) the superseded dataset record carries the two missing EventKeys, the row-count disagreement and the cause, so a later reader cannot mistake it for a qualified input; (c) ADR-013 records finalized pinning and partition reconciliation as an addendum, reopens ADR-002, ADR-010, ADR-011 and ADR-012 explicitly, and is registered in the architecture catalogue; (d) spec_revision was raised. Section 5: only the four target contracts, their dependency fields, spec_revision and docs/spec/** changed; T030 through T038, the P04 phase README and todo/README.md were not touched; no status, attempt, evidence pointer, SHA, review record, approval datum, runtime model or agent configuration was altered (verified programmatically: the config is identical to base 9284d56 outside spec_revision and the four target tasks' depends_on fields). Placement and wording decisions recorded for the reviewer: (1) the new sections were added rather than rewriting existing Outcome/Acceptance clauses, and every existing clause of the four contracts is preserved; the FROZEN_FROM_BASELINE_6C31778 marker was deliberately left in place, as T040 already carried a 2026-09-16 Owner-amendment note alongside it and the direction did not ask for a marker change; (2) ADR-013 and T034 were added to References beyond the direction's enumerated minimum: ADR-013 is the policy home for the window and reconciliation these contracts consume, and T034 is the source of the blocked-check reason-code set T042 reuses; neither replaces a required reference and no enumerated reference was dropped; (3) T043's dependency field is unchanged because the direction added dependencies only for T040, T041 and T042, so T037 and T038 appear in T043's References only; (4) the spec record cites the superseded run's own failed baseline comparison (Swap 3,157 against the pinned 3,159) only to explain why that run is not an input, and no task may cite the 2026-09-17 baseline in place of a run's own report. Inherent unknowns that remain open and are not Owner decisions: whether the second pool has nonzero hooks is decided only when T038 resolves its PoolKey on chain, and it selects which T043 path applies; T036 (APPROVED) and T038 both qualify a dataset containing the ZZZ/USDG reference pool but over different ranges, and this amendment leaves T036 untouched as directed while naming T038's per-pool datasets as the P04 input; the superseded dataset lives outside this repository (/home/lpdev/lp-data) and is explicitly not to be read, repaired or re-qualified by any P04 task.
unresolved_questions: todo/README.md section 6 states that T023 and T043 determine the selected PoolKey's hook identity and semantics, while no PoolKey has been selected and the pinned pools are Owner-pinned research fixtures. The recorded direction marks this text inconsistency OUT OF SCOPE for a SPEC-layer amendment and requires it to be raised to the Owner rather than edited; the same applies to CLAUDE.md and README.md naming FLYBRAIN/USDG as the example research target while the pinned pools are ZZZ/USDG and the Owner-pinned second pool. Both files need an Owner decision plus a CONTRACT/INTENT-layer or documentation route.

Whether either included pool has nonzero hooks is unresolved and can only be settled when T038 resolves the second pool's PoolKey on chain (the reference pool's hooks are pinned at 0x0). It decides whether T043 produces hook packs or the zero-hooked-pool empty-set evidence defined by this amendment; T043's contract covers both paths and expects to record the observed value.

The reference pool's dataset exists in two generations after this amendment: T036's approved 54946237..55946237 dataset and T038's cold re-acquisition over the pinned ten-million-block window. This amendment leaves T036 untouched as directed and names T038's per-pool datasets as the P04 input; if the Owner wants the older generation formally demoted to historical evidence in T036's own text, that requires a separate amendment outside this SPEC-layer scope.
